name: vim-anywhere
title: Vim Anywhere
description: Easily modify any selected text in vim.
author: jrddp

commands.name: modify-selection-in-vim
commands.title: Modify Selection in Vim
commands.description: Opens the selected text in a Vim buffer and pastes it back into the original app after :wq.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
